title: An Indonesian volcano helped bring Frankenstein to life
body: In April 1815, Mount Tambora on the island of Sumbawa produced the most powerful eruption in recorded history. Its haze cooled the globe, and 1816 became the ‘Year Without a Summer’, with failed harvests in Europe and North America. That June, incessant rain kept Mary Godwin, soon to be Mary Shelley, indoors by Lake Geneva with Lord Byron, where a ghost-story contest led her to begin Frankenstein.

slides.question: How did an eruption in Indonesia end up shaping a novel begun in Switzerland?
options: Its haze brought a cold, rainy 1816
Its ash buried Mary Shelley’s home
Its glow inspired the monster’s look
slides.explanation: Tambora’s haze cooled the globe, 1816 became the ‘Year Without a Summer’, and incessant June rain kept Mary Godwin indoors by Lake Geneva, where a ghost-story contest began Frankenstein.
